Model selection committed and LLM rebuild succeeded, but the GUI reported the aggregate settings apply remained pending. This is not presented as a wholly successful provider apply.

Automatic GPU discovery reported worker_executable_missing in the source checkout. The visible GPU device card does not establish successful device enumeration or Vulkan readiness.

An intermediate attempted restoration of 26B did not commit before an earlier restart; that process correctly retained the then-committed E4B CPU selection. The decisive 26B restart followed explicit query and persisted-byte confirmation.

That manufactured installed manifest was not counted as product promotion evidence; the separate normal-cache installation below closes that gap.
actionable_controlled_startup_failure.gui_text: Couldn't load Gemma 4 26B on Vulkan. Check the selected GPU and available GPU/system memory, or explicitly choose another supported model. No CPU or cloud fallback is used.

limits_not_reclassified_as_passes: No owned model/GPU execution or translation was performed by these source/UI/provisioning probes.
Controlled missing-runtime presentation is not a reproduction of GPU memory exhaustion or proof of device discovery/readiness.
The public transfer was intentionally cancelled; complete real-asset product promotion used the normal pinned-cache framework path, not a complete new remote download.
The initial manually staged installed manifest proved integrity/error display only; the separate product-created manifest and observed atomic promotion provide installation evidence.
Prepare terminal failures after successful installation/reuse are preserved as failures at the intentionally unavailable runtime, not reported as completed readiness.

The first optional promotion screenshot captured a minimized 160x28 window and is excluded from evidence. The later 09-offline-installed-reuse-runtime-unavailable.png is the valid owned-window capture.
The F2 gpu_only internal-boundary repair has 103 behavior and 5 architecture passes; no new post-F2 GUI execution is claimed.

This record does not establish installed-distribution launch, native CPU/MTP or fallback behavior, Self/Peer GPU overlap, performance comparison, full-suite success or whole-issue completion. Those are separate owners' evidence domains.
